author: Reuters
description:
Two Pakistani pilots are undergoing centrifuge drills and training for life in weightlessness as Pakistan prepares to select its first astronaut for China's Tiangong space station. The mission would be a first for Pakistan and reflects wider space cooperation with Beijing, including Chinese-launched Pakistani satellites and a Pakistani rover planned for China's Chang'e 8 lunar mission around 2028. Ariba Shahid has more.
